imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The grooming-mirror guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 108 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 39.45. The only query near the target band was two impressions for official jet-lag guidance at average position 8; the strongest relevant page test was two impressions for the contractor-estimate guide at position 8.5. The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs with no errors or warnings.
searchConsole.decision: No query or page had enough repeatable evidence for a Data-led article. The report informed discovery work instead: three non-overlapping intents are placed on three department hubs and the Library, supported by twelve reciprocal contextual links, homepage discovery, a regenerated sitemap and the publication manifest.
searchConsole.ignored: The two jet-lag-query impressions, two contractor-guide impressions, one charity-page impression at position 11 and six homepage impressions were deliberately ignored as too small or non-specific for topic selection, title rewriting or cluster expansion.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the grooming-mirror buying guide. The subscription audit and garment-measurement field guide remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready recurring-subscription audit and cancellation file that separates the service contract from the payment authorization, preserves the controlling terms and renewal notice, records cancellation proof, flags the vacated 2024 federal Click-to-Cancel amendment, and routes post-cancellation charges to the correct issuer or bank process.
authority.cluster: Household cash-flow and consumer-resolution authority, with reciprocal paths from the established two-account bill system, gym-membership contract, credit-card billing-error and household-records guides; the grooming-mirror and garment-measurement pages expand separate grooming-tool and clothing-fit clusters.
authority.opportunity: Three qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for the FTC consumer-education team, CFPB consumer-education team and Consumer Action; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Grooming, Life and Style: how to choose a grooming mirror for a specific view and room, how to inventory and cancel recurring subscriptions with proof, and how to compare clothing across inconsistent size charts using garments that already fit. The mirror page serves purchase intent, the subscription file is the authority asset, and the measurement guide explores a reusable style skill. No page is Data-led because the current analytics sample is too weak.
